text:
Dear Mr Näf,

following our phone call, here is my claim in writing. On Tuesday 23 June 2026, while I was at work, jewellery, a laptop and a camera were stolen from my flat at Seestrasse 46 in Wädenswil.

I've attached a list of everything that's missing, with the value of each item. The total is CHF 6,050.

You asked me who else lives in the flat. Nobody does, I've lived there alone since 2023, so no one from my household can have had anything to do with it.

I have the original receipts for every item on the list. My partner Ben Egli, who doesn't live with me but helps me with paperwork, found the last two in my desk at the weekend, so they're all together now.

There was no urgency about any of this afterwards. Nothing needed doing that couldn't wait until I'd heard from you, so I simply left it to you to tell me the next steps.

For your files I'm also attaching the confirmation CSS sent me when I first reported the theft, and a copy of my policy.

Kind regards,
Maya Widmer
